data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Herodion', meaning 'strong, brave'. In the Bible, Herodion is the name of a place in Judea where Herod the Great built a fortress. The name Verney can evoke images of courage and strength. The name Verney carries the meaning “Strong, Brave” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Verney usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Verney total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Verney has been used in various cultures throughout history. In England, it is believed to have originated as a surname from one of the many Verney families who owned large estates. The name may also have French origins, meaning 'shining jewel'. Regardless of its origins, the name Verney has become synonymous with strength, bravery, and nobility.
data.spiritual_significance: Verney is a name that can inspire us to be strong in our faith and brave in our daily lives. It can remind us of the courage and strength of characters in the Bible, such as Herodion, who stood firm in their convictions despite adversity. It can also serve as a reminder to seek out our own inner strength and to face challenges with bravery and determination, trusting in the guidance and support of God.
